turns.assessment: The outage is isolated to the bidirectional S04–S14 line. Simultaneous OSC loss on the same physical 90.1 km segment—E10 in the S04→S14 direction and reciprocal E27 in the S14→S04 direction—plus input LOS at the immediately downstream amplifiers is the signature of both fibres being severed. Stable pump currents and unaffected S04–S20 services argue against amplifier, ROADM, or S20-path faults.

proposals.rationale: E10 has OSC_LOS (O123), while its reciprocal physical span E27 simultaneously has OSC_LOS (O124). The next amplifiers in each direction report input LOS (O1 and O2), and all services involving S14 fail together. This strongly identifies a cut of the paired fibres on the 90.1 km cable segment.
An extreme loss increase could suppress both traffic and OSC, but simultaneous complete loss on both reciprocal fibres is much more characteristic of a cable cut.
